The Division Franchise Surpasses 50 Million Players as Anniversary and New DLC Approach

29 Oct 2026, 11:46 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Gaming Desk · Source: www.ign.com

Image: www.ign.com — Creative Commons

Key takeawaysUbisoft and developer Massive Entertainment have announced that *The Division* franchise has surpassed 50 million players globally. The milestone arrives as the looter-shooter series approaches its 10th anniversary, following its initial debut in 2016. Originally unveil

Ubisoft and developer Massive Entertainment have announced that The Division franchise has surpassed 50 million players globally. The milestone arrives as the looter-shooter series approaches its 10th anniversary, following its initial debut in 2016.

Originally unveiled at E3 in 2013, the franchise expanded with the launch of The Division 2 in 2019, alongside various spin-off titles released over the years. To support the ongoing player base, Massive Entertainment is preparing to release a new expansion for The Division 2 titled Echoes of Central Park on November 3.

Upcoming DLC and Leadership Changes for The Division 3

The upcoming Echoes of Central Park expansion introduces a horror-themed flashback campaign, increased stash space, and a level boost for players. Meanwhile, work continues on the officially announced Tom Clancy's The Division 3 at Massive Entertainment.

Leadership on the third installment has transitioned following the departure of former executive producer Julian Gerighty, who moved to DICE. Mathias Karlson, who served as game director on The Division 2, has taken over as creative director for The Division 3. Massive Entertainment has assured fans that development remains a priority and that the core team behind the franchise is still in place.

Practical Implications and Verification

For players and fans following the franchise, the latest announcements outline both near-term content and long-term development plans.

  • What is confirmed: The franchise has exceeded 50 million total players. The Division 2 will receive the Echoes of Central Park DLC on November 3. The Division 3 is officially in active development at Massive Entertainment under creative director Mathias Karlson.
  • What remains unknown: Ubisoft has not yet announced a release window or launch date for The Division 3.
  • How to verify: Readers can review the original reporting and official statements directly through [IGN's coverage of The Division series](https://www.ign.com/articles/the-division-series-50-million-players).
